scope: Five feats, four druid circles, their supporting spells and environment mechanics, and separate 10/30-second rests with persistent class resources.

backend_and_http.command: PYTHONPATH=.qa-python;.;tests python -m unittest test_general_feats_0818 test_druid_circles_0818 test_druid_circle_spells_0818 test_environment_0818 test_rest_resources_0818 test_app_shell_http_0818 -q
backend_and_http.notes: Uses an in-memory database and local HTTP test server. Includes real damage, resources, spell fields, stone-wall persistence, AI escapes, polymorph, free spells at zero mana, rest interruption and reconnect. aiohttp printed its existing non-failing AppKey warning.

updated_existing_rest_checks.notes: Updated existing expectations after an earlier broad pattern also selected obsolete single-rest expectations. Preserved interruption, PvP, exact completion/cooldown boundary, save and reconnect scenarios. No backend edits in this pass.

javascript.additional_review: 14 earlier ad hoc UI/integration assertions and 10 SVG XML checks were reported passing by the UI implementer; they are not counted as a retained regression suite.

source_integrity.notes: Counts reflect the pre-package scan. The package tool independently reads back every archived file and compares its SHA-256 against the archive's own manifest.

verification_limits: No full historical regression suite, live deployment, browser gameplay session, or physical phone test for UI_11.

The 2D world has no boats and does not support vertical stone ramps/bridges; those particular D&D interactions are absent. Horizontal walls, damage, collision, water movement and supported spell variants are implemented.
